metadata.methodology: 15 Intelligence metrics normalized [0,1], averaged → composite ability; Pareto = non-dominated by per-request cost; Power-law exponential mapping f(x) = x^p where p = log(0.5)/log(median_pareto)
metadata.arithmetic: All intermediate calculations use fractions.Fraction for exact rational arithmetic up to the point before the power-law mapping; the mapping f(x) = x^p with non-integer p inherently requires float, but the parameter p is determined by exact Fraction median of Pareto models

index_mapping.type: power-law: f(x) = x^p where p = log(0.5) / log(median_pareto)
index_mapping.x_axis: p_x determined by median normalized_cost of Pareto models
index_mapping.y_axis: p_y determined by median ability_rescaled of Pareto models
index_mapping.note: f(0)=0, f(1)=1 always; f(median)=0.5; smooth continuous monotonic function

per_request_cost.non_reasoning: Output_tokens = (Total - TTFT) × Speed; Cost = (In × InPrice + Out × OutPrice) / 1M
per_request_cost.reasoning_with_time: Output_tokens = (Total - TTFT) × Speed; Cost = (In × InPrice + Out × OutPrice) / 1M
per_request_cost.reasoning_no_time: Output_tokens = Total × Speed; Cost = (In × InPrice + Out × OutPrice) / 1M
